items.title: A $500,000 Roth Portfolio Loaded With These Dividend Stocks Pays $40,000 a Year and the IRS Gets None of It
items.summary: The IRS collects thousands of dollars a year from dividend investors who never stopped to ask which account their income stocks actually live in. Six high-yield names reveal exactly how much that placement question costs at every tax bracket.

items.title: Can Robotics Reshape How Chevron Runs Its Global Operations?
items.summary: CVX is using robots, drones and remote tools to cut hazardous work, lower costs and sharpen inspection data across field operations.

items.title: Wall Street Analysts See Chevron (CVX) as a Buy: Should You Invest?
items.summary: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), Chevron (CVX) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?

items.title: Chevron Has More Going for It Than Higher Oil Prices
items.summary: Wall Street sees modest upside for Chevron, but a seven-quarter streak of earnings beats, a 20-year AI power deal, and a valuation well below the broader market suggest analysts are still underestimating what this stock can do.

items.title: America’s Strategic Oil Reserves Are at 44-Year Lows — And Trump Just Gave Away Another 40 Million Barrels
items.summary: America's emergency oil stockpile is draining toward levels not seen since Reagan was president, and the administration just authorized another massive release at the worst possible moment for global supply. What gets left behind matters far more than what goes out the door.

items.title: Diesel’s supply crunch may hit CFOs through freight contracts
